title: Stability of global wave front sets by perturbations of frames
summary: In this paper we consider the Gabor wave front set of ultradistributions in the frame of ultradifferentiable functions. We prove that such a wave front set, defined through a Gabor frame on a regular lattice, is not affected by perturbations of the frame, in two different cases: when we consider $\varepsilon$-perturbations of Christensen type, and when we consider nonstationary Gabor frames.
